what_this_is: Pre-analysis freeze for the RQ3 prompting-strategy inferential analysis. Every file listed below existed with the recorded SHA-256 BEFORE code/01_run_rq3_strategy_inference.py was executed for the first time. No RQ3 strategy-comparison p-value had been computed, inspected or used at this point.
status: POST-HOC / EXPLORATORY. Estimation procedure pre-specified and frozen 2026-09-21 for RQ1/RQ2 and applied unchanged; RQ3 contrasts declared before testing but after the descriptive results were known.

declared.unit: benchmark item carrying its five runs
declared.scope: within model, within dataset; no pooling across models or datasets
declared.invalid_outputs: counted as incorrect on the attributable denominator; primary analysis NOT conditioned on validity

permutation.type: paired item-level, whole five-run vector swapped
permutation.macro_f1: recomputed from swapped confusion matrices, not decomposed

bootstrap.type: item-cluster, shared resampled index per dataset

declared.correction: Holm within dataset across 30 primary comparisons (5 models x 3 pairs x 2 metrics)
declared.secondary: exact McNemar on majority-vote (>=3/5) effective correctness, own family

preconditions_verified_before_freeze.five_runs_not_treated_as_independent: per-item arrays are (item x strategy x run) = (699,3,5) / (622,3,5); the run axis is never folded into the item axis; independent units are 699 / 622 items, not 3,495 / 3,110 records and not 5 runs
